results.title: Pay Calculator | Wage, Salary & Take-Home Pay After Tax
results.description:
## What You Can Work Out With This Pay Calculator
This pay calculator turns an annual, monthly, fortnightly, weekly, daily, or hourly figure into net pay after tax for any selected financial year, and models the pieces most tools skip: the Low Income Tax Offset, salary packaging, novated leases, Division 293, and the Medicare Levy Surcharge.

Use it for the practical decisions: what lands in your bank account each cycle, how much PAYG is being withheld — the [PAYG tax calculator](https://www.wagecalculator.com.au/tax-withheld-calculator) shows the ATO Schedule 1 figure for a standard payslip — and whether a different salary, work pattern, or [salary sacrifice](https://www.wagecalculator.com.au/salary-sacrifice) setup changes the answer. For job offers, compare two roles after tax with the [salary comparison tool](https://www.wagecalculator.com.au/compare), or work backwards from a target net figure with the [reverse salary calculator](https://www.wagecalculator.com.au/reverse-salary-calculator).

### Use this pay calculator when
- You want net pay for every cycle side-by-side — monthly, fortnightly, weekly, or hourly.
- You earn above the Medicare Levy Surcharge threshold and want the surcharge included.
- You want HECS/HELP, LITO, and salary sacrifice modelled in one breakdown.
- You want calculations that run in your browser, with no sign-up.

### Monthly, fortnightly and weekly take-home pay
A salary entered in any period maps to the matching net amount for every other cycle — including the monthly and fortnightly views payroll runs on. For pay-cycle-specific tables and worked examples, the dedicated [take-home pay calculator](https://www.wagecalculator.com.au/take-home-pay-calculator) shows weekly and fortnightly figures side-by-side, and the [fortnightly take-home pay guide](https://www.wagecalculator.com.au/guides/fortnightly-take-home-pay) explains the arithmetic.

## Frequently Asked Questions
### How do you calculate take-home pay?
This pay calculator runs those steps automatically for the selected financial year, including the offsets and levies most tools skip.
